# LOADING PROCESSED MICROBIOME DATA

```{r}
# ================================================================================
# LOADING PROCESSED MICROBIOME DATA - R
# ================================================================================

# Load required libraries
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readr)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
})

cat("================================================================================\n")
cat("LOADING PROCESSED MICROBIOME DATA - R\n")
cat("================================================================================\n")

# Configuration - Update this path to match your data location
mypath <- "/Users/mathieuvanhove/Desktop/Work/DeepImpact/Weeds_wheat/paper_1/data/matrice_phase1/"
df_dir <- file.path(mypath, "df")

cat("Loading data from:", df_dir, "\n")

# File paths
# metadata_file <- file.path(df_dir, "metadata_bacteria_1282ASVs.csv")
# otu_count_file <- file.path(df_dir, "otu_bacteria_table_R_1282ASVs.csv")
# otu_normalized_file <- file.path(df_dir, "otu_bacteria_normalized_v4.csv")
# taxonomy_file <- file.path(df_dir, "tax_bacteria_R_1282ASVs.csv")

metadata_file <- file.path(df_dir, "metadata_bacteria_1314ASVs.csv")
otu_count_file <- file.path(df_dir, "otu_bacteria_table_R_1314ASVs.csv")
otu_normalized_file <- file.path(df_dir, "otu_bacteria_normalized_v4.csv")
taxonomy_file <- file.path(df_dir, "tax_bacteria_R_1314ASVs.csv")


# Check if files exist
files_to_check <- list(
  metadata = metadata_file,
  otu_count = otu_count_file,
  otu_normalized = otu_normalized_file,
  taxonomy = taxonomy_file
)

cat("\n1. Checking file availability...\n")
missing_files <- c()
for (name in names(files_to_check)) {
  filepath <- files_to_check[[name]]
  if (file.exists(filepath)) {
    cat("✓", name, ":", basename(filepath), "\n")
  } else {
    cat("✗", name, ":", basename(filepath), "- FILE NOT FOUND\n")
    missing_files <- c(missing_files, name)
  }
}

if (length(missing_files) > 0) {
  cat("\n⚠️  Missing files:", paste(missing_files, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  cat("Please ensure all files are generated from the previous processing step.\n")
  stop("Required files are missing.")
}

# ================================================================================
# 2. LOAD METADATA
# ================================================================================
cat("\n2. Loading metadata...\n")

tryCatch({
  metadata_all <- read_csv(metadata_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
  cat("✓ Metadata loaded:", nrow(metadata_all), "rows x", ncol(metadata_all), "columns\n")
  cat("  Columns:", paste(colnames(metadata_all), collapse = ", "), "\n")
  
  if ("Sample_Type" %in% colnames(metadata_all)) {
    sample_types <- table(metadata_all$Sample_Type)
    cat("  Sample types:", paste(names(sample_types), "=", sample_types, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  }
}, error = function(e) {
  cat("✗ Error loading metadata:", e$message, "\n")
  stop("Failed to load metadata")
})

# ================================================================================
# 3. LOAD OTU COUNT MATRIX
# ================================================================================
cat("\n3. Loading OTU count matrix...\n")

tryCatch({
  otumat <- read_delim(otu_count_file, delim = "\t", show_col_types = FALSE)
  
  # Set first column as row names if it contains ASV IDs
  if (ncol(otumat) > 1 && is.character(otumat[[1]])) {
    rownames(otumat) <- otumat[[1]]
    otumat <- otumat[, -1]
  }
  
  # Convert to matrix for easier manipulation
  otumat <- as.matrix(otumat)
  
  cat("✓ OTU count matrix loaded:", nrow(otumat), "ASVs x", ncol(otumat), "samples\n")
  cat("  ASV range:", rownames(otumat)[1], "to", rownames(otumat)[nrow(otumat)], "\n")
  cat("  Sample range:", colnames(otumat)[1], "to", colnames(otumat)[ncol(otumat)], "\n")
  cat("  Read count range:", min(otumat), "to", max(otumat), "\n")
  cat("  Total reads:", format(sum(otumat), big.mark = ","), "\n")
}, error = function(e) {
  cat("✗ Error loading OTU count matrix:", e$message, "\n")
  stop("Failed to load OTU count matrix")
})

# ================================================================================
# 4. LOAD OTU NORMALIZED MATRIX
# ================================================================================
cat("\n4. Loading OTU normalized matrix...\n")

tryCatch({
  otumat_normalized <- read_delim(otu_normalized_file, delim = "\t", show_col_types = FALSE)
  
  # Set first column as row names if it contains ASV IDs
  if (ncol(otumat_normalized) > 1 && is.character(otumat_normalized[[1]])) {
    rownames(otumat_normalized) <- otumat_normalized[[1]]
    otumat_normalized <- otumat_normalized[, -1]
  }
  
  # Convert to matrix
  otumat_normalized <- as.matrix(otumat_normalized)
  
  cat("✓ OTU normalized matrix loaded:", nrow(otumat_normalized), "ASVs x", ncol(otumat_normalized), "samples\n")
  cat("  Value range:", sprintf("%.6f", min(otumat_normalized)), "to", sprintf("%.6f", max(otumat_normalized)), "\n")
  
  # Check normalization (should sum to 1 per sample)
  sample_sums <- colSums(otumat_normalized)
  cat("  Sample sums range:", sprintf("%.6f", min(sample_sums)), "to", sprintf("%.6f", max(sample_sums)), "\n")
  
  if (all(abs(sample_sums - 1.0) < 0.001)) {
    cat("  ✓ Normalization verified: all samples sum to 1.0\n")
  } else {
    cat("  ⚠️  Normalization warning: samples don't sum to exactly 1.0\n")
  }
}, error = function(e) {
  cat("✗ Error loading OTU normalized matrix:", e$message, "\n")
  stop("Failed to load OTU normalized matrix")
})

# ================================================================================
# 5. LOAD TAXONOMY MATRIX
# ================================================================================
cat("\n5. Loading taxonomy matrix...\n")

tryCatch({
  taxmat <- read_delim(taxonomy_file, delim = "\t", show_col_types = FALSE)
  
  cat("✓ Taxonomy matrix loaded:", nrow(taxmat), "rows x", ncol(taxmat), "columns\n")
  cat("  Taxonomic columns:", paste(colnames(taxmat), collapse = ", "), "\n")
  
  if ("Kingdom" %in% colnames(taxmat)) {
    kingdom_counts <- table(taxmat$Kingdom)
    cat("  Kingdom distribution:", paste(names(kingdom_counts), "=", kingdom_counts, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  }
  
  if ("Phylum" %in% colnames(taxmat)) {
    n_phyla <- length(unique(taxmat$Phylum))
    cat("  Number of phyla:", n_phyla, "\n")
    
    top_phyla <- head(sort(table(taxmat$Phylum), decreasing = TRUE), 5)
    cat("  Top 5 phyla:", paste(names(top_phyla), "=", top_phyla, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  }
}, error = function(e) {
  cat("✗ Error loading taxonomy matrix:", e$message, "\n")
  stop("Failed to load taxonomy matrix")
})

# ================================================================================
# 6. DATA SYNCHRONIZATION CHECKS
# ================================================================================
cat("\n6. Performing data synchronization checks...\n")

# Check ASV synchronization
otu_asvs <- rownames(otumat)
norm_asvs <- rownames(otumat_normalized)
tax_asvs <- if ("Cluster" %in% colnames(taxmat)) taxmat$Cluster else c()

cat("ASVs in count matrix:", length(otu_asvs), "\n")
cat("ASVs in normalized matrix:", length(norm_asvs), "\n")
cat("ASVs in taxonomy matrix:", length(tax_asvs), "\n")

if (identical(otu_asvs, norm_asvs)) {
  cat("✓ Count and normalized matrices have identical ASVs\n")
} else {
  cat("⚠️  Count and normalized matrices have different ASVs\n")
}

if (length(tax_asvs) > 0 && all(otu_asvs %in% tax_asvs)) {
  cat("✓ All OTU ASVs have taxonomy information\n")
} else if (length(tax_asvs) > 0) {
  missing_tax <- sum(!otu_asvs %in% tax_asvs)
  cat("⚠️ ", missing_tax, "ASVs missing taxonomy information\n")
}

# Check sample synchronization
otu_samples <- colnames(otumat)
norm_samples <- colnames(otumat_normalized)
meta_samples <- if ("sample" %in% colnames(metadata_all)) metadata_all$sample else c()

cat("Samples in count matrix:", length(otu_samples), "\n")
cat("Samples in normalized matrix:", length(norm_samples), "\n")
cat("Samples in metadata:", length(meta_samples), "\n")

if (identical(otu_samples, norm_samples)) {
  cat("✓ Count and normalized matrices have identical samples\n")
} else {
  cat("⚠️  Count and normalized matrices have different samples\n")
}

if (length(meta_samples) > 0 && all(otu_samples %in% meta_samples)) {
  cat("✓ All OTU samples have metadata information\n")
} else if (length(meta_samples) > 0) {
  missing_meta <- sum(!otu_samples %in% meta_samples)
  cat("⚠️ ", missing_meta, "samples missing metadata information\n")
}

# ================================================================================
# 7. CREATE USEFUL DERIVED OBJECTS
# ================================================================================
cat("\n7. Creating derived objects for analysis...\n")

# Create taxonomy lookup vectors
if ("Cluster" %in% colnames(taxmat)) {
  cluster_2_phylum <- if ("Phylum" %in% colnames(taxmat)) setNames(taxmat$Phylum, taxmat$Cluster) else c()
  cluster_2_class <- if ("Class" %in% colnames(taxmat)) setNames(taxmat$Class, taxmat$Cluster) else c()
  cluster_2_family <- if ("Family" %in% colnames(taxmat)) setNames(taxmat$Family, taxmat$Cluster) else c()
  cluster_2_order <- if ("Order" %in% colnames(taxmat)) setNames(taxmat$Order, taxmat$Cluster) else c()
  cluster_2_genus <- if ("Genus" %in% colnames(taxmat)) setNames(taxmat$Genus, taxmat$Cluster) else c()
  
  cat("✓ Created taxonomy lookup vectors:\n")
  cat("  • Phylum:", length(cluster_2_phylum), "entries\n")
  cat("  • Class:", length(cluster_2_class), "entries\n")
  cat("  • Order:", length(cluster_2_order), "entries\n")
  cat("  • Family:", length(cluster_2_family), "entries\n")
  cat("  • Genus:", length(cluster_2_genus), "entries\n")
}

# Create pot to plant mapping if possible
if (all(c("pot", "species") %in% colnames(metadata_all))) {
  pot_2_plant <- setNames(metadata_all$species, metadata_all$pot)
  pot_2_plant <- pot_2_plant[!duplicated(names(pot_2_plant))]  # Remove duplicates
  cat("✓ Created pot-to-plant mapping:", length(pot_2_plant), "entries\n")
} else {
  pot_2_plant <- c()
  cat("⚠️  Could not create pot-to-plant mapping (missing columns)\n")
}

# Create sample type mapping
if (all(c("sample", "Sample_Type") %in% colnames(metadata_all))) {
  sample_info <- setNames(metadata_all$Sample_Type, metadata_all$sample)
  cat("✓ Created sample type mapping:", length(sample_info), "entries\n")
} else {
  sample_info <- c()
  cat("⚠️  Could not create sample type mapping (missing columns)\n")
}

# Create summary statistics
n_asvs <- nrow(otumat)
n_samples <- ncol(otumat)
total_reads <- sum(otumat)
mean_reads_per_sample <- mean(colSums(otumat))
mean_asvs_per_sample <- mean(colSums(otumat > 0))

cat("\n", paste(rep("=", 80), collapse = ""), "\n")
cat("DATA LOADING COMPLETE!\n")
cat(paste(rep("=", 80), collapse = ""), "\n")
cat("📊 LOADED VARIABLES:\n")
cat("  • metadata_all:", nrow(metadata_all), "x", ncol(metadata_all), "- Sample metadata\n")
cat("  • otumat:", nrow(otumat), "x", ncol(otumat), "- ASV count matrix\n")
cat("  • otumat_normalized:", nrow(otumat_normalized), "x", ncol(otumat_normalized), "- Normalized abundances\n")
cat("  • taxmat:", nrow(taxmat), "x", ncol(taxmat), "- Taxonomy information\n")
cat("\n🔧 HELPER OBJECTS:\n")
cat("  • cluster_2_phylum: Phylum lookup vector\n")
cat("  • cluster_2_class: Class lookup vector\n")
cat("  • cluster_2_family: Family lookup vector\n")
cat("  • cluster_2_order: Order lookup vector\n")
cat("  • cluster_2_genus: Genus lookup vector\n")
cat("  • pot_2_plant: Pot to plant species mapping\n")
cat("  • sample_info: Sample type mapping\n")
cat("\n SUMMARY STATISTICS:\n")
cat("  • Total ASVs:", format(n_asvs, big.mark = ","), "\n")
cat("  • Total samples:", format(n_samples, big.mark = ","), "\n")
cat("  • Total reads:", format(total_reads, big.mark = ","), "\n")
cat("  • Mean reads per sample:", format(round(mean_reads_per_sample), big.mark = ","), "\n")
cat("  • Mean ASVs per sample:", format(round(mean_asvs_per_sample), big.mark = ","), "\n")
cat("\n Ready for downstream analysis!\n")
cat(paste(rep("=", 80), collapse = ""), "\n")
```

```{r}
library(phyloseq)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)

# ---- config ----
df_dir  <- file.path(mypath, "df/")

# small helper: same “first token before _” cleaner you used (if needed later)
first_token <- function(x) sapply(strsplit(x, "_"), `[`, 1)

# general builder with diagnostics
build_physeq <- function(otu_df, tax_df, meta_df, 
                         ranks, control_col_patterns = character(),
                         sample_id_transform = identity,
                         dataset_name = "dataset") {

  message("---- ", dataset_name, " ----")

  # 1) drop control samples by column name pattern
  if (length(control_col_patterns)) {
    for (pat in control_col_patterns) {
      drop_n <- sum(grepl(pat, colnames(otu_df)))
      if (drop_n > 0) message("Dropping ", drop_n, " columns matching '", pat, "'")
      otu_df <- dplyr::select(otu_df, -tidyselect::matches(pat))
    }
  }

  # 2) drop zero‑abundance taxa
  keep_taxa <- rowSums(otu_df) > 0
  if (!all(keep_taxa)) {
    message("Dropping ", sum(!keep_taxa), " zero‑abundance taxa.")
    otu_df <- otu_df[keep_taxa, , drop = FALSE]
  }

  # 3) sample ID cleaning (optional)
  colnames(otu_df) <- sample_id_transform(colnames(otu_df))
  rownames(meta_df) <- sample_id_transform(rownames(meta_df))

  # 4) align samples
  shared_samples <- intersect(colnames(otu_df), rownames(meta_df))
  message("Samples: OTU=", ncol(otu_df), " | META=", nrow(meta_df), " | shared=", length(shared_samples))
  if (length(shared_samples) == 0) stop("No shared sample IDs between OTU and metadata.")
  # subset & reorder
  otu_df  <- otu_df[, shared_samples, drop = FALSE]
  meta_df <- meta_df[shared_samples, , drop = FALSE]

  # 5) align taxonomy to OTU taxa
  # if taxonomy has a 'Cluster' column, use it as rownames then drop it
  if ("Cluster" %in% colnames(tax_df)) {
    rownames(tax_df) <- tax_df$Cluster
    tax_df$Cluster <- NULL
  }
  # coerce rank columns
  missing_ranks <- setdiff(ranks, colnames(tax_df))
  if (length(missing_ranks)) {
    tax_df[, missing_ranks] <- NA
  }
  tax_df <- tax_df[, ranks, drop = FALSE]

  shared_taxa <- intersect(rownames(otu_df), rownames(tax_df))
  message("Taxa: OTU=", nrow(otu_df), " | TAX=", nrow(tax_df), " | shared=", length(shared_taxa))
  if (length(shared_taxa) == 0) stop("No shared taxa IDs between OTU and taxonomy.")
  # subset & reorder
  otu_df <- otu_df[shared_taxa, , drop = FALSE]
  tax_df <- tax_df[shared_taxa, , drop = FALSE]

  # 6) build phyloseq
  OTU <- otu_table(as.matrix(otu_df), taxa_are_rows = TRUE)
  TAX <- tax_table(as.matrix(tax_df))
  META <- sample_data(meta_df)

  ps <- phyloseq(OTU, TAX, META)

  # 7) final prints
  message("phyloseq: taxa=", ntaxa(ps), " | samples=", nsamples(ps))
  # quick mismatch checkers if you ever need them:
  # setdiff(colnames(otu_df), rownames(meta_df))
  # setdiff(rownames(tax_df), rownames(otu_df))

  ps
}
```

# 3.1 Drivers of wheat root microbiome composition across soil types

## 3.1.1. Community composition and assembly

### Sequential ANOVA

SEQUENTIAL PERMANOVA - BACTERIA/FUNGI



```{r}
# ============================================================================
# SEQUENTIAL PERMANOVA - BACTERIA
# ============================================================================
bacteria_seq <- adonis2(
  bacteria_bray ~ soil + species + soil:species,
  data = metadata_bacteria,
  permutations = 999,
  by = "terms"  # Sequential - order matters!
)

# Extract sequential R²
bacteria_seq_df <- as.data.frame(bacteria_seq)
bacteria_seq_df$R2_percent <- bacteria_seq_df$R2 * 100
bacteria_seq_df$Cumulative_R2 <- cumsum(bacteria_seq_df$R2_percent)

print(bacteria_seq_df[1:3, c("R2", "R2_percent", "Cumulative_R2", "Pr(>F)")])

# Calculate true residual
total_explained_bacteria <- sum(bacteria_seq_df$R2[1:3], na.rm = TRUE)
residual_bacteria <- 1 - total_explained_bacteria

cat(sprintf("\nTotal explained variance: %.1f%%\n", total_explained_bacteria * 100))
cat(sprintf("Residual (unexplained): %.1f%%\n", residual_bacteria * 100))

# ============================================================================
# SEQUENTIAL PERMANOVA - FUNGI  
# ============================================================================
fungi_seq <- adonis2(
  fungi_bray ~ soil + species + soil:species,
  data = metadata_fungi,
  permutations = 999,
  by = "terms"
)

fungi_seq_df <- as.data.frame(fungi_seq)
fungi_seq_df$R2_percent <- fungi_seq_df$R2 * 100
fungi_seq_df$Cumulative_R2 <- cumsum(fungi_seq_df$R2_percent)

print(fungi_seq_df[1:3, c("R2", "R2_percent", "Cumulative_R2", "Pr(>F)")])

total_explained_fungi <- sum(fungi_seq_df$R2[1:3], na.rm = TRUE)
residual_fungi <- 1 - total_explained_fungi

cat(sprintf("\nTotal explained variance: %.1f%%\n", total_explained_fungi * 100))
cat(sprintf("Residual (unexplained): %.1f%%\n", residual_fungi * 100))
```

```{r}
# ============================================================================
cat("\n=== FUNGI - Marginal Effects (Type III) ===\n")
fungi_marginal <- adonis2(
  fungi_bray ~ soil * species,
  data = metadata_fungi,
  permutations = 999,
  by = "margin"
)
print(fungi_marginal)
```




### PERMANOVA - adonis

#### Bray-Curtis 


Bray-Curtis is already compositionally aware (divides by total abundance)
Robust to different sequencing depths
No transformation needed

```{r}
library(vegan)
library(phyloseq)
library(tidyverse)

# ============================================================================
# 1. LOAD DATA
# ============================================================================

bacteria_ps <- physeq_bacteria
fungi_ps <- physeq_fungi

# ============================================================================
# 2. CALCULATE DISTANCE MATRICES
# ============================================================================

# Bacteria
bacteria_bray <- phyloseq::distance(bacteria_ps, method = "bray")

# Fungi
fungi_bray <- phyloseq::distance(fungi_ps, method = "bray")

# ============================================================================
# 3. EXTRACT METADATA (SEPARATE FOR EACH)
# ============================================================================

# Bacteria metadata
metadata_bacteria <- as(sample_data(bacteria_ps), "data.frame")
metadata_bacteria$soil <- as.factor(metadata_bacteria$soil)
metadata_bacteria$species <- as.factor(metadata_bacteria$species)

# Fungi metadata
metadata_fungi <- as(sample_data(fungi_ps), "data.frame")
metadata_fungi$soil <- as.factor(metadata_fungi$soil)
metadata_fungi$species <- as.factor(metadata_fungi$species)

# Quick check: sample sizes
cat("Sample sizes:\n")
cat(sprintf("  Bacteria: %d samples\n", nrow(metadata_bacteria)))
cat(sprintf("  Fungi:    %d samples\n\n", nrow(metadata_fungi)))

# ============================================================================
# 4. RUN PERMANOVA (adonis2) - BACTERIA
# ============================================================================

cat("\n", rep("=", 80), "\n", sep = "")
cat("BACTERIA - PERMANOVA (adonis2)\n")
cat(rep("=", 80), "\n\n", sep = "")

# Main effects + interaction
bacteria_permanova <- adonis2(
  bacteria_bray ~ soil * species,
  data = metadata_bacteria,  # Use bacteria metadata
  permutations = 999,
  by = "margin"  # Type III SS - tests each term while accounting for others
)

print(bacteria_permanova)

# Extract R² values
bacteria_results <- as.data.frame(bacteria_permanova)
bacteria_results$R2_percent <- bacteria_results$R2 * 100

cat("\n--- Effect Sizes (Bacteria) ---\n")
print(bacteria_results[, c("R2", "R2_percent", "F", "Pr(>F)")])

# ============================================================================
# 5. RUN PERMANOVA (adonis2) - FUNGI
# ============================================================================

cat("\n", rep("=", 80), "\n", sep = "")
cat("FUNGI - PERMANOVA (adonis2)\n")
cat(rep("=", 80), "\n\n", sep = "")

fungi_permanova <- adonis2(
  fungi_bray ~ soil * species,
  data = metadata_fungi,  # Use fungi metadata
  permutations = 999,
  by = "margin"
)

print(fungi_permanova)

# Extract R² values
fungi_results <- as.data.frame(fungi_permanova)
fungi_results$R2_percent <- fungi_results$R2 * 100

cat("\n--- Effect Sizes (Fungi) ---\n")
print(fungi_results[, c("R2", "R2_percent", "F", "Pr(>F)")])

# ============================================================================
# 6. COMPARE SEQUENTIAL vs MARGINAL (OPTIONAL)
# ============================================================================

cat("\n", rep("=", 80), "\n", sep = "")
cat("COMPARISON: Sequential (by='terms') vs Marginal (by='margin')\n")
cat(rep("=", 80), "\n\n", sep = "")

# Sequential (like Type I SS in ANOVA) - bacteria
bacteria_sequential <- adonis2(
  bacteria_bray ~ soil + species + soil:species,
  data = metadata_bacteria,
  permutations = 999,
  by = "terms"  # Each term after previous ones
)

cat("BACTERIA - Sequential partitioning:\n")
print(bacteria_sequential)

# Sequential - fungi
fungi_sequential <- adonis2(
  fungi_bray ~ soil + species + soil:species,
  data = metadata_fungi,
  permutations = 999,
  by = "terms"
)

cat("\nFUNGI - Sequential partitioning:\n")
print(fungi_sequential)
```

```{r}

# ============================================================================
# 6. CREATE SUMMARY TABLE 
# ============================================================================

create_permanova_summary <- function(permanova_result, kingdom_name) {
  
  df <- as.data.frame(permanova_result)
  
  # Remove residual and total rows
  df <- df[!rownames(df) %in% c("Residual", "Total"), ]
  
  # Ensure R2_percent column exists
  if (!"R2_percent" %in% colnames(df)) {
    df$R2_percent <- df$R2 * 100
  }
  
  # Add effect size categories
  df$Effect_Category <- cut(
    df$R2,
    breaks = c(0, 0.01, 0.06, 0.14, 1),
    labels = c("Negligible", "Small", "Medium", "Large"),
    include.lowest = TRUE
  )
  
  # Add kingdom and term
  df$Kingdom <- kingdom_name
  df$Term <- rownames(df)
  
  # Calculate relative importance
  total_r2 <- sum(df$R2, na.rm = TRUE)
  df$Relative_Importance_Pct <- (df$R2 / total_r2) * 100
  
  return(df)
}

bacteria_summary <- create_permanova_summary(bacteria_permanova, "Bacteria")
fungi_summary <- create_permanova_summary(fungi_permanova, "Fungi")

combined_summary <- rbind(bacteria_summary, fungi_summary)

# Clean up for display
combined_summary_clean <- combined_summary %>%
  select(Kingdom, Term, R2, R2_percent, F, `Pr(>F)`, 
         Effect_Category, Relative_Importance_Pct) %>%
  arrange(Kingdom, desc(R2))

cat("\n", rep("=", 80), "\n", sep = "")
cat("COMBINED SUMMARY - BACTERIA vs FUNGI\n")
cat(rep("=", 80), "\n\n", sep = "")

print(combined_summary_clean, digits = 3)
```

### db-RDA




```{r - db-RDA - soil A}
library(phyloseq)
library(vegan)
library(RVAideMemoire)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(readr)

# ----- CONFIG -----
soil_value <- "resistant"     # change to "Permissive" for the other soil: Permissive; resistant
group_col  <- "species"       # the constraining variable in sample_data()
out_dir    <- "/Users/mathieuvanhove/Desktop/Work/DeepImpact/Weeds_wheat/paper_1/data/db-RDA/"
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# ----- subset to soil -----
physeq_soil <- subset_samples(physeq, soil == soil_value)
physeq_soil <- prune_samples(sample_sums(physeq_soil) > 0, physeq_soil)

# ----- build sample × taxa matrix (samples in rows) -----
OT <- as(otu_table(physeq_soil), "matrix")
if (taxa_are_rows(physeq_soil)) OT <- t(OT)

# drop all-zero taxa to avoid singularities
OT <- OT[, colSums(OT) > 0, drop = FALSE]

# relative abundance per sample
row_sums <- rowSums(OT)
row_sums[row_sums == 0] <- 1
OT_rel <- OT / row_sums

# ====== (A) Hellinger + Euclidean + RDA (this is the “hel correction”) ======
OT_hel <- decostand(OT_rel, method = "hellinger")  # sqrt of relative abundance

# sample metadata (ensure same order & SampleID column)
md <- data.frame(sample_data(physeq_soil)) %>% rownames_to_column("SampleID")
stopifnot(group_col %in% names(md))
md <- md[match(rownames(OT_hel), md$SampleID), , drop = FALSE]

# RDA on Hellinger space
form <- reformulate(group_col)   # ~ species
rda_hel <- rda(OT_hel, md[, group_col, drop = FALSE])

# quick summaries / plots
print(rda_hel)
# MVA helpers (optional):
# MVA.plot(rda_hel, fac = md[[group_col]])
# MVA.synt(rda_hel)

# Site scores (sample scores on constrained axes)
sc_hel <- scores(rda_hel, display = "sites")
hel_df <- data.frame(sc_hel[, 1:2, drop = FALSE]) %>%
  rownames_to_column("SampleID") %>%
  rename(RDA1_hel = RDA1, RDA2_hel = RDA2) %>%
  left_join(md[, c("SampleID", group_col)], by = "SampleID") %>%
  mutate(soil = soil_value)

write_csv(hel_df, file.path(out_dir, paste0("soil_", soil_value, "_RDA_hellinger.csv")))

# ====== (B) OPTIONAL: Bray–Curtis + dbRDA (capscale/dbrda) for comparison ======
# (This is your original logic, kept here as a reference path.)
dist_bc <- phyloseq::distance(physeq_soil, method = "bray")

# You can use capscale() (recommended) or dbrda(); both are vegan:
dbrda_bc <- capscale(dist_bc ~ md[[group_col]], add = TRUE)  # Cailliez correction via add=TRUE
# dbrda_bc <- dbrda(dist_bc ~ md[[group_col]], add = TRUE)   # alternative, similar result

print(dbrda_bc)
# MVA.plot(dbrda_bc, fac = md[[group_col]])
# MVA.synt(dbrda_bc)

# Extract site scores safely (Bray–Curtis dbRDA)
sc_bc <- scores(dbrda_bc, display = "sites")

# Automatically detect the first two axes (column names)
col_names_bc <- colnames(sc_bc)[1:2]

bc_df <- data.frame(sc_bc[, 1:2, drop = FALSE]) %>%
  rownames_to_column("SampleID") %>%
  rename_with(~ paste0("dbRDA", seq_along(.), "_bc"), all_of(col_names_bc)) %>%
  left_join(md[, c("SampleID", group_col)], by = "SampleID") %>%
  mutate(soil = soil_value)

# ====== If you only want the Hellinger-corrected coordinates exported, hel_df is your table ======

```

### comparison with permanova

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# db-RDA: Species Effects Within Soil Context
# ============================================================================

library(phyloseq)
library(vegan)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

run_within_soil_dbrda <- function(physeq, soil_value, group_col = "species") {
  
  # Subset to soil
  physeq_soil <- subset_samples(physeq, soil == soil_value)
  physeq_soil <- prune_samples(sample_sums(physeq_soil) > 0, physeq_soil)
  
  # Calculate Bray-Curtis
  dist_bc <- phyloseq::distance(physeq_soil, method = "bray")
  
  # Get metadata
  md <- data.frame(sample_data(physeq_soil))
  
  # db-RDA constrained by species
  dbrda_result <- capscale(dist_bc ~ md[[group_col]], add = TRUE)
  
  # Extract variance explained
  total_var <- dbrda_result$tot.chi
  constrained_var <- dbrda_result$constr.chi
  prop_constrained <- constrained_var / total_var
  
  # Permutation test
  anova_result <- anova.cca(dbrda_result, by = "margin", permutations = 999)
  
  # Return results
  list(
    soil = soil_value,
    dbrda = dbrda_result,
    prop_constrained = prop_constrained,
    p_value = anova_result$`Pr(>F)`[1],
    anova = anova_result
  )
}

# Run for both soils
results_resistant <- run_within_soil_dbrda(physeq_bacteria, "resistant")
results_permissive <- run_within_soil_dbrda(physeq_bacteria, "Permissive")

# Summary
cat(sprintf("Within-soil species effects (db-RDA):\n"))
cat(sprintf("  Resistant:  %.1f%% (p = %.3f)\n",
            results_resistant$prop_constrained * 100,
            results_resistant$p_value))
cat(sprintf("  Permissive: %.1f%% (p = %.3f)\n",
            results_permissive$prop_constrained * 100,
            results_permissive$p_value))
```

```{r - pcoa-plot, fig.width=8, fig.height=6, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(phyloseq)
library(ggplot2)
library(vegan)
library(gridExtra)

create_pcoa_plot <- function(physeq, color_by = "soil", shape_by = NULL) {
  bc_dist <- phyloseq::distance(physeq, method = "bray")
  pcoa <- cmdscale(bc_dist, k = 2, eig = TRUE)
  variance_explained <- round(100 * pcoa$eig / sum(pcoa$eig), 1)
  
  pcoa_df <- data.frame(
    PC1 = pcoa$points[,1],
    PC2 = pcoa$points[,2],
    Sample = rownames(pcoa$points)
  )
  
  metadata <- data.frame(sample_data(physeq))
  pcoa_df <- cbind(pcoa_df, metadata[pcoa_df$Sample, ])
  
  p <- ggplot(pcoa_df, aes_string(x = "PC1", y = "PC2", color = color_by))
  
  if (!is.null(shape_by)) {
    p <- p + geom_point(aes_string(shape = shape_by), size = 3, alpha = 0.7)
  } else {
    p <- p + geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.7)
  }
  
  p <- p + stat_ellipse(type = "t", level = 0.95, linetype = 2)
  
  p <- p +
    labs(
      title = NULL,
      x = paste0("PC1 (", variance_explained[1], "%)"),
      y = paste0("PC2 (", variance_explained[2], "%)")
    ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.position = c(1, 1),
    legend.justification = c(1, 1),
    legend.box.background = element_rect(color = "black", size = 0.3)
  )
  if (color_by == "soil") {
    p <- p +
      theme(
        legend.title = element_text(size = 14),   # Legend title size
        legend.text = element_text(size = 12),    # Legend item text size
        legend.key.size = unit(1.2, "lines")      # Size of the color key boxes
      ) +
      scale_color_manual(
        values = c("resistant" = "#D55E00", "Permissive" = "#0072B2"),
        labels = c("resistant" = "mixed-system", "Permissive" = "cereal-dominated"),
        name = "Soil Type"
      )
  }
  
  return(p)
}
```

```{r}
# Load required libraries
library(phyloseq)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggtree)
library(dplyr)
library(data.tree)
library(tidyr)

# ==== Assume you've already run perform_lefse() ====
# bacteria_lefse <- perform_lefse(physeq, "soil", lda_threshold = 2.0)

# ---- Only continue if results exist ----
if (nrow(bacteria_lefse) > 0) {
  
  # Define taxonomic columns
  tax_cols <- c("Kingdom", "Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family", "Genus", "Species")
  
  # Build tree using taxonomic hierarchy
  bacteria_lefse$pathString <- apply(bacteria_lefse[, tax_cols], 1, function(x)
    paste(c("Root", na.omit(x)), collapse = "/"))
  bacteria_lefse$pathString <- paste0(bacteria_lefse$pathString, "/", bacteria_lefse$OTU)
  
  tree_obj <- as.Node(bacteria_lefse)
  tree_phylo <- as.phylo.Node(tree_obj)
  tree_phylo$tip.label <- gsub(".*/", "", tree_phylo$tip.label)
  
  # Define function to get last informative taxonomic level
  get_last_taxon <- function(row) {
    last <- tail(na.omit(row[!row %in% c("unidentified", "Multi-affiliation")]), 1)
    if (length(last) == 0) return("unclassified") else return(last)
  }
  bacteria_lefse$Last_Taxon <- apply(bacteria_lefse[, tax_cols], 1, get_last_taxon)
  
  # 1. Replace underscores with spaces
  bacteria_lefse$Last_Taxon <- gsub("_", " ", bacteria_lefse$Last_Taxon)
  
  # 2. Remove strain codes like "JMC 19062" (uppercase letters + numbers)
  bacteria_lefse$Last_Taxon <- gsub("\\b[A-Z]{2,}\\s*\\d{2,}\\b", "", bacteria_lefse$Last_Taxon)
  
  # 3. Normalize "sp" to "sp." consistently
  bacteria_lefse$Last_Taxon <- gsub("\\bsp\\b", "sp.", bacteria_lefse$Last_Taxon)
  bacteria_lefse$Last_Taxon <- gsub("sp\\.\\.+", "sp.", bacteria_lefse$Last_Taxon)
  
  # 4. Trim extra spaces
  bacteria_lefse$Last_Taxon <- gsub("\\s{2,}", " ", bacteria_lefse$Last_Taxon)
  bacteria_lefse$Last_Taxon <- trimws(bacteria_lefse$Last_Taxon)
  
  # Final formatting: add newline between Genus and Species only if not "sp."
  bacteria_lefse$Last_Taxon <- gsub(
    "^(\\S+)\\s+(?!sp\\.?$)(\\S+)$",    # Two words, second one NOT "sp." (requires perl=TRUE)
    "\\1\n\\2",
    bacteria_lefse$Last_Taxon,
    perl = TRUE
  )
  
  # Ensure "Genus sp." stays on one line — undo any newline before sp.
  bacteria_lefse$Last_Taxon <- gsub("\\nsp\\.", " sp.", bacteria_lefse$Last_Taxon)
  
  # Final whitespace cleanup
  bacteria_lefse$Last_Taxon <- trimws(bacteria_lefse$Last_Taxon)

  # Prepare metadata for ggtree
  tree_meta <- bacteria_lefse
  rownames(tree_meta) <- tree_meta$OTU
  
  # Create signed LDA: negative for "resistant", positive for "Permissive"
  tree_meta$signed_LDA <- ifelse(tree_meta$Group == "resistant", -tree_meta$LDA, tree_meta$LDA)
  
  # Custom phylum colors (edit as needed)
  # phyl_col_d <- c(
  #   "Ascomycota" = "#87CEEB",       # sky blue
  #   "Basidiomycota" = "#32CD32",    # lime green
  #   "Glomeromycota" = "#8B4513",    # brown
  #   "Chytridiomycota" = "#FF69B4",  # hot pink
  #   "unidentified" = "#A9A9A9"
  # )
  phyl_col_d = c(
      "Proteobacteria"= "#332288",
      "Bacteroidetes"= "#999933",
      "Firmicutes"= "#CC6677",
      "Actinobacteria"= "#88CCEE",
      "Acidobacteria"= "#999933",
      "Verrucomicrobia"= "#DDCC77",
      "Planctomycetes"= "#44AA99",
      "Chloroflexi"= "#882255",
      "unidentified"= "#AAAAAA",
      "Multi-affiliation"= "#000000"
  )
  # ==== Tree plot ====
  p <- ggtree(tree_phylo, layout = "circular", size = 0.5) %<+% tree_meta +
    geom_tippoint(aes(color = Phylum), size = 2, na.rm = TRUE) +
    geom_tiplab2(
      aes(label = Last_Taxon),
      size = 4.5,
      align = TRUE,
      offset = 7,
      linesize = 0.1,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = phyl_col_d) +
    theme(legend.position = "right")
  
  # ==== Add heatmap for signed LDA ====
  p2 <- gheatmap(
    p,
    tree_meta %>% select(signed_LDA),
    offset = 150, # fungi 150
    width = 0.15,
    colnames = FALSE
  ) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(
      low = "#D55E00",  # resistant
      mid = "white",
      high = "#0072B2", # permissive
      midpoint = 0,
      name = "LDA\nScore"
    )
    

  # ==== Show plot ====
  print(p2)
}
```

### NST and pNST

Normalized Stochasticity Ratio (NST) or Phylogenetic NST (pNST)

#### NST - Normalized Stochasticity Ratio (NST) 

```{r}
library(NST)
# Other helpful packages
library(phyloseq)
library(vegan)
library(ape)      # for phylogenetic distances
library(dplyr)
```

Prepare your data
```{r}
# Sample data with grouping
meta <- as(sample_data(physeq), "data.frame")
meta$Group <- interaction(meta$soil, meta$family)  # e.g., "resistant.Fabaceae"

# OTU table as matrix (samples x taxa)
otu <- as(otu_table(physeq), "matrix")
if (taxa_are_rows(physeq)) {
  otu <- t(otu)
}

# Optional: filter low prevalence taxa
otu <- otu[, colSums(otu > 0) >= 5]  # at least in 5 samples
```

Run NST per group (abundance-based, Bray-Curtis)


```{r - plant family}
library(phyloseq)
library(dplyr)
library(NST)

## ----- 1) Prepare matrices and group labels (make sure rows match) -----
meta <- as(sample_data(physeq), "data.frame")
meta$Group <- interaction(meta$soil, meta$family, drop = TRUE)

otu <- as(otu_table(physeq), "matrix")
if (taxa_are_rows(physeq)) otu <- t(otu)

# align rows: sample IDs must match and be in the same order
common_ids <- intersect(rownames(meta), rownames(otu))
meta <- meta[common_ids, , drop = FALSE]
otu  <- otu [common_ids, , drop = FALSE]

stopifnot(identical(rownames(meta), rownames(otu)))

# Optional light prevalence filter to help convergence
otu <- otu[, colSums(otu > 0) >= 2, drop = FALSE]

# build list of group-specific community matrices
otu_list <- split.data.frame(otu, meta$Group)  # list of (samples x taxa)

## ----- 2) Robust runner for one group -----
library(NST)
library(tidyr)

# sequential results container
nst_rows <- list()

# choose the group order you want to run
groups_to_run <- names(otu_list)   # or e.g. c("Permissive.Apiaceae","resistant.Apiaceae", ...)

for (g in groups_to_run) {
  cat("\n--- Running:", g, " ---\n")
  mat <- otu_list[[g]]
  if (is.null(mat)) {
    nst_rows[[g]] <- data.frame(Group=g, NST=NA, SES=NA, RC=NA, N_sto=NA, N_det=NA, status="no_matrix")
    next
  }

  # remove empty samples
  mat <- mat[rowSums(mat) > 0, , drop = FALSE]

  # guard tiny cases (tweak thresholds if you like)
  if (nrow(mat) < 3 || ncol(mat) < 2) {
    nst_rows[[g]] <- data.frame(Group=g, NST=NA, SES=NA, RC=NA, N_sto=NA, N_det=NA, status="too_small")
    next
  }

  # build one-column group df with sample IDs as rownames
  grp <- data.frame(group = rep(g, nrow(mat)),
                    row.names = rownames(mat),
                    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

  # run exactly like your working manual call
  out <- tryCatch(
    NST::tNST(
      comm        = as.matrix(mat),
      group       = grp,
      dist.method = "bray",
      abundance   = TRUE,
      rand        = 1000,
      output.rand = FALSE
      # , nworker = 1  # uncomment if your NST is flaky with parallel
    ),
    error = function(e) e
  )

  if (inherits(out, "error")) {
    cat("   -> ERROR:", out$message, "\n")
    nst_rows[[g]] <- data.frame(Group=g, NST=NA, SES=NA, RC=NA, N_sto=NA, N_det=NA, status=paste0("error: ", out$message))
    next
  }

  # sometimes NST returns empty vectors; protect against that
  get1 <- function(x) if (is.null(x) || length(x)==0) NA_real_ else as.numeric(x[1])

  nst_rows[[g]] <- data.frame(
    Group = g,
    NST   = get1(out$index.grp$NST.i.bray),  # group-level NST
    SES   = NA_real_,                        # not provided in index.grp; leave NA or compute if needed
    RC    = NA_real_,
    N_sto = get1(out$index.grp$ST.i.bray),   # total stochasticity (group level)
    N_det = get1(out$index.grp$MST.i.bray),  # deterministic portion (group level)
    status = "ok",
    check.names = FALSE
  )

  # Optional: also print a quick summary
  cat(sprintf("   size=%d  NST=%.3f  ST=%.3f  MST=%.3f\n",
      nrow(mat),
      nst_rows[[g]]$NST,
      nst_rows[[g]]$N_sto,
      nst_rows[[g]]$N_det))
}

# bind rows at the end (still sequential execution above)
nst_df <- do.call(rbind, nst_rows)

# split Group into Soil / Family for plotting
nst_df <- separate(nst_df, Group, into=c("Soil","Family"), sep="\\.", remove=FALSE)

print(nst_df)

## ----- 4) (Optional) quick plot -----
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# Reorder families to show side-by-side by soil
nst_df <- nst_df %>%
  mutate(Family = factor(Family, levels = unique(Family)))

# Plot NST
ggplot(nst_df, aes(x = Family, y = NST, fill = Soil)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7, color = "black") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Permissive" = "#D55E00", "resistant" = "#0072B2")) +
  labs(
    title = "Normalized Stochasticity Ratio (NST) by Plant Family and Soil",
    y = "NST (0 = deterministic, 1 = stochastic)",
    x = "Plant Family",
    fill = "Soil"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

#### pNST (phylogenetic; βMNTD)


```{r}
get_col_by_pattern <- function(df, patterns) {
  for (pat in patterns) {
    hit <- grep(pat, colnames(df), value = TRUE)
    if (length(hit) >= 1) return(as.numeric(df[[hit[1]]]))
  }
  NA_real_
}

run_pNST_one <- function(mat, gname, physeq,
                         rand = 1000,
                         abundance_weighted = TRUE,
                         min_samples = 3,
                         nworker = 1) {

  # 1) tree
  tr <- phy_tree(physeq, errorIfNULL = FALSE)
  if (is.null(tr))
    return(tibble::tibble(Group=gname, pNST=NA_real_, pN_sto=NA_real_, pN_det=NA_real_,
                          mode = if (abundance_weighted) "phylo/abund" else "phylo/PA",
                          status="no_tree"))

  # 2) align taxa between mat and tree
  taxa_in <- intersect(colnames(mat), tr$tip.label)
  if (length(taxa_in) < 2)
    return(tibble::tibble(Group=gname, pNST=NA_real_, pN_sto=NA_real_, pN_det=NA_real_,
                          mode = if (abundance_weighted) "phylo/abund" else "phylo/PA",
                          status="no_overlap_taxa"))

  mat <- mat[, taxa_in, drop = FALSE]
  tr  <- ape::keep.tip(tr, taxa_in)

  # 3) drop empty samples
  mat <- mat[rowSums(mat) > 0, , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(mat) < min_samples || ncol(mat) < 2)
    return(tibble::tibble(Group=gname, pNST=NA_real_, pN_sto=NA_real_, pN_det=NA_real_,
                          mode = if (abundance_weighted) "phylo/abund" else "phylo/PA",
                          status="too_small"))

  # 4) root if needed
  if (!ape::is.rooted(tr)) tr <- ape::root(tr, outgroup = tr$tip.label[1], resolve.root = TRUE)

  # 5) per‑group working dir to avoid collisions
  safe <- make.names(gname)                  # sanitize for filesystem
  wd <- file.path(tempdir(), paste0("pNST_", safe))
  dir.create(wd, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

  # 6) tell pNST there is just one group (avoid odd chars)
  grp <- data.frame(group = factor(rep("all", nrow(mat))), row.names = rownames(mat))

  # 7) run pNST
  out <- tryCatch(
    suppressWarnings(
      NST::pNST(
        comm               = as.matrix(mat),
        group              = grp,
        tree               = tr,
        abundance.weighted = abundance_weighted,
        rand               = rand,
        output.rand        = FALSE,
        pd.wd              = wd,     # <-- unique per group
        nworker            = nworker
      )
    ),
    error = function(e) e
  )

  if (inherits(out, "error") || is.null(out$index.grp) || nrow(out$index.grp) < 1) {
    return(tibble::tibble(Group=gname, pNST=NA_real_, pN_sto=NA_real_, pN_det=NA_real_,
                          mode = if (abundance_weighted) "phylo/abund" else "phylo/PA",
                          status = if (inherits(out, "error")) paste0("error: ", out$message) else "no_result"))
  }

  idx <- out$index.grp[1, , drop = FALSE]

  tibble::tibble(
    Group  = gname,
    pNST   = get_col_by_pattern(idx, c("^NST\\.i", "^NST\\.i\\.(bMNTD|uMNTD)$")),
    pN_sto = get_col_by_pattern(idx, c("^ST\\.i",  "^ST\\.i\\.(bMNTD|uMNTD)$")),
    pN_det = get_col_by_pattern(idx, c("^MST\\.i", "^MST\\.i\\.(bMNTD|uMNTD)$")),
    mode   = if (abundance_weighted) "phylo/abund" else "phylo/PA",
    status = "ok"
  )
}

# Use the SAME phyloseq you used to build otu_list (tree aligned), e.g. physeq_bnti
ps_for_nst <- physeq_bnti  # or physeq if that’s truly the same taxa set

groups_to_run <- names(otu_list)
cat("Running pNST (abundance‑weighted) for", length(groups_to_run), "groups...\n")

pnst_rows <- lapply(groups_to_run, function(g) {
  cat("[pNST] ", g, "\n")
  run_pNST_one(otu_list[[g]], g, ps_for_nst, rand = 1000, abundance_weighted = TRUE, nworker = 1)
})

pnst_tab <- dplyr::bind_rows(pnst_rows) |>
  tidyr::separate(Group, into = c("Soil","Species"), sep = "\\.", remove = FALSE)

# show status counts so you see what happened after the first group
print(table(pnst_tab$status, useNA = "ifany"))

# fallback to PA mode where needed
need_pa <- which(!is.finite(pnst_tab$pNST))
if (length(need_pa) > 0) {
  cat("\nRe‑running pNST in presence/absence mode for", length(need_pa), "groups that failed...\n")
  for (i in need_pa) {
    g <- pnst_tab$Group[i]
    out_row <- run_pNST_one(otu_list[[g]], g, ps_for_nst, rand = 1000, abundance_weighted = FALSE, nworker = 1)
    if (is.finite(out_row$pNST)) {
      pnst_tab[i, c("pNST","pN_sto","pN_det","mode","status")] <- out_row[1, c("pNST","pN_sto","pN_det","mode","status")]
    } else {
      pnst_tab$mode[i]   <- out_row$mode
      pnst_tab$status[i] <- out_row$status
    }
  }
  }
  
  print(pnst_tab)
  write.csv(pnst_tab, paste0(mypath0 , "NST/pNST_bacteria.csv"))

  # --- plot (optional) -------------------------------------------------------
  
  ggplot(filter(pnst_tab, status == "ok"),
         aes(x = Species, y = pNST, fill = Soil)) +
    geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.75), width = 0.65, color = "black") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed") +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,1), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, .05))) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Permissive" = "#D55E00", "resistant" = "#0072B2")) +
    labs(title = "Phylogenetic NST (βMNTD) by plant family and soil",
         subtitle = "Abundance-weighted; presence/absence used only for groups that failed",
         y = "pNST (0 = deterministic, 1 = stochastic)", x = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

```{r}
make_otu_list_from_physeq <- function(ps,
                                      group_vars = c("soil","species"),
                                      drop_empty_samples = TRUE,
                                      drop_empty_taxa = TRUE,
                                      clean_names = TRUE) {
  stopifnot(inherits(ps, "phyloseq"))

  # 1) metadata – preserve rows/rownames
  md <- as(phyloseq::sample_data(ps), "data.frame")
  if (nrow(md) == 0L) stop("sample_data(ps) returned 0 rows; check your phyloseq object.")

  # 2) make sure grouping columns exist
  miss <- setdiff(group_vars, colnames(md))
  if (length(miss)) stop("Missing grouping variables in sample_data(): ",
                         paste(miss, collapse = ", "))

  # 3) build a safe group ID
  to_chr <- function(x) as.character(x)
  g1 <- to_chr(md[[group_vars[1]]])
  g2 <- to_chr(md[[group_vars[2]]])

  if (isTRUE(clean_names)) {
    # replace spaces and punctuation to make list names safe
    fix <- function(x) gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", x)
    g1 <- fix(g1); g2 <- fix(g2)
  }

  md$Group <- paste(g1, g2, sep = ".")

  # 4) split sample IDs by Group
  sids <- rownames(md)
  split_sids <- split(sids, md$Group)

  # 5) build one matrix (samples × taxa) per group
  mats <- lapply(split_sids, function(ids) {
    ps_sub <- phyloseq::prune_samples(ids, ps)
    M <- as(phyloseq::otu_table(ps_sub), "matrix")
    if (phyloseq::taxa_are_rows(ps_sub)) M <- t(M)

    if (isTRUE(drop_empty_samples) && nrow(M) > 0) {
      M <- M[rowSums(M) > 0, , drop = FALSE]
    }
    if (isTRUE(drop_empty_taxa) && ncol(M) > 0) {
      M <- M[, colSums(M) > 0, drop = FALSE]
    }
    M
  })

  # 6) keep only non-empty groups (≥1 sample row)
  mats <- mats[vapply(mats, nrow, 1L) > 0]

  # diagnostics if everything got filtered out
  if (!length(mats)) warning("All groups were empty after filtering. ",
                             "Consider setting drop_empty_* = FALSE to inspect.")

  mats
}

otu_list <- make_otu_list_from_physeq(physeq_filtered,
                                      group_vars = c("soil","species"),
                                      drop_empty_samples = TRUE,
                                      drop_empty_taxa = TRUE)

length(otu_list); head(names(otu_list))

# 2) Prepare tree (root + align with dataset)

tr_all <- phy_tree(physeq_filtered, errorIfNULL = FALSE)
stopifnot(!is.null(tr_all))
if (!is.rooted(tr_all)) tr_all <- root(tr_all, outgroup = tr_all$tip.label[1], resolve.root = TRUE)

# keep only taxa shared by OTU table and tree
shared_taxa <- intersect(taxa_names(physeq_filtered), tr_all$tip.label)
physeq_bnti <- prune_taxa(shared_taxa, physeq_filtered)
tr_all      <- keep.tip(tr_all, shared_taxa)
phy_tree(physeq_bnti) <- tr_all

# 3) βNTI for one group (correct null)

bNTI_one_group <- function(mat, tr,
                           rand = 999,
                           abundance_weighted = TRUE,
                           min_samples = 2,
                           min_taxa = 3,
                           eps = 1e-9) {
  if (is.null(tr)) return(list(summary = tibble(status="no_tree"), bNTI_vals = numeric(0)))

  # taxa for this group
  taxa_in <- intersect(colnames(mat), tr$tip.label)
  if (length(taxa_in) < min_taxa)
    return(list(summary=tibble(status="too_few_taxa", n_samp=nrow(mat), n_tax=length(taxa_in)), bNTI_vals=numeric(0)))

  mat <- mat[, taxa_in, drop = FALSE]
  mat <- mat[rowSums(mat) > 0, , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(mat) < min_samples)
    return(list(summary=tibble(status="too_few_samples", n_samp=nrow(mat), n_tax=ncol(mat)), bNTI_vals=numeric(0)))

  # subtree + distances
  tr_sub <- keep.tip(tr, taxa_in)
  if (!is.rooted(tr_sub)) tr_sub <- root(tr_sub, outgroup = tr_sub$tip.label[1], resolve.root = TRUE)
  pdist  <- cophenetic(tr_sub)

  # observed βMNTD
  bMNTD_obs <- as.matrix(picante::comdistnt(as.matrix(mat), pdist, abundance.weighted = abundance_weighted))

  # null via **tip‑label shuffle on the subtree** (relabel; do NOT reorder)
  n_samp <- nrow(mat)
  null_vals <- array(NA_real_, dim = c(n_samp, n_samp, rand))
  taxa <- colnames(mat)
  for (r in seq_len(rand)) {
    tr_perm <- tr_sub
    tr_perm$tip.label <- sample(tr_perm$tip.label)
    pdist_null <- cophenetic(tr_perm)
    null_vals[,,r] <- as.matrix(picante::comdistnt(as.matrix(mat), pdist_null, abundance.weighted = abundance_weighted))
  }

  m_null <- apply(null_vals, c(1,2), mean, na.rm = TRUE)
  s_null <- apply(null_vals, c(1,2), sd,   na.rm = TRUE)
  s_null[!is.finite(s_null) | s_null == 0] <- eps

  bNTI_mat <- (bMNTD_obs - m_null) / s_null
  diag(bNTI_mat) <- NA_real_

  vals <- bNTI_mat[upper.tri(bNTI_mat)]
  vals <- vals[is.finite(vals)]
  if (!length(vals)) return(list(summary=tibble(status="no_pairs"), bNTI_vals=numeric(0)))

  summary <- tibble(
    status       = "ok",
    mode         = if (abundance_weighted) "phylo/abund" else "phylo/PA",
    pairs        = length(vals),
    mean_bNTI    = mean(vals),
    frac_var_sel = mean(vals >  2),
    frac_hom_sel = mean(vals < -2),
    frac_stoch   = mean(vals >= -2 & vals <= 2)
  )
  list(summary = summary, bNTI_vals = vals)
}
```

## 3.1.2. Differential microbial enrichment by co-cultivated weed species


### metagenomeSeq
```{r - metagenomeSeq}
library(metagenomeSeq)
# https://www.bioconductor.org/packages/release/bioc/html/metagenomeSeq.html
physeq_log2fold <- subset_samples(physeq, soil == "resistant")  # Adjust to "Permissive" or "resistant" 
#physeq_log2fold <- physeq_soilB # physeq_soilA; physeq_soilB

# Ensure "species" is a factor in the metadata
sample_data(physeq_log2fold)$species <- as.factor(sample_data(physeq_log2fold)$species)
physeq_log2fold_filtered <- filter_taxa(physeq_log2fold, function(x) sum(x > 0) >= 5, TRUE)
MRobj <- phyloseq_to_metagenomeSeq(physeq_log2fold_filtered) # MRexperiment object
# Unlike DESeq2, which uses a geometric mean-based normalization, CSS accounts for sparsity by calculating a cumulative sum percentile cutoff.
MRobj <- cumNorm(MRobj)  # Perform Cumulative Sum Scaling (CSS) normalization
#MRobj <- wrenchNorm(MRobj, condition = metadata$species)  # Instead of cumNorm
MRobj <- filterData(MRobj, present = 0.05, depth = 5)
normalized_counts <- MRcounts(MRobj, norm = TRUE)  # Extract CSS-normalized counts

metadata <- data.frame(sample_data(physeq_log2fold_filtered))  # Extract metadata
metadata <- metadata[colnames(normalized_counts), ]  # Align metadata with normalized counts
metadata$species <- as.factor(metadata$species)
metadata$species <- relevel(metadata$species, ref = "wheat x wheat")


# Recreate the model matrix with "wheat alone" as the reference
mod <- model.matrix(~ species, data = metadata)
settings <- zigControl(maxit = 50, verbose = TRUE)
fit <- fitZig(obj = MRobj, mod = mod, useCSSoffset = TRUE, control = settings)
#fit <- fitLogNormal(obj = MRobj, mod = mod, B = 1000)
global_results <- MRcoefs(fit)

# Get all unique species
species_list <- levels(metadata$species)
wheat_species <- "wheat x wheat"  # Reference group
pairwise_results <- list()  # Store results

for (sp in species_list) {
  if (sp != wheat_species) {
    # Extract results for each pairwise comparison
    res <- MRcoefs(fit, coef = paste0("species", sp), adjustMethod = "bonferroni", alpha = 0.05, number = dim(normalized_counts)[1])
    sig_results <- res[res$adjPvalues < 0.05, ]  # Adjusted p-value threshold
    pairwise_results[[sp]] <- sig_results
    print(paste("comparison:", wheat_species, "vs", sp, dim(sig_results)[1]))
  }
}
# Convert results to a single DataFrame
pairwise_results_df <- do.call(rbind, pairwise_results)

this_path <- '/Users/mathieuvanhove/Desktop/Work/DeepImpact/Weeds_wheat/paper_1/data/results_v4/'

output_dir <- file.path(this_path, "metagenomeSeq_species")
if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) {
  dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}

write.csv(pairwise_results_df, file = file.path(output_dir, "MetaSeq_bacteria_Resistant_CSS_wheat_x_wheat.csv"), row.names = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(DESeq2)
species <- "wheat x wheat"
wheat_species <- species

physeq_log2fold <- subset_samples(physeq, soil == "resistant")
# physeq_log2fold <- physeq_soilB  # Adjust to "Permissive" or "resistant" 

metadata <- as.data.frame(sample_data(physeq_log2fold))
metadata$species <- factor(metadata$species)

diagdds <- phyloseq_to_deseq2(physeq_log2fold, ~ species)
diagdds <- estimateSizeFactors(diagdds, type = "poscounts")
diagdds <- DESeq(diagdds, test = "Wald", fitType = "parametric")

species_list <- levels(metadata$species)
all_sig_results <- data.frame()

for (sp in species_list) {
  if (sp != wheat_species) {
    res <- results(diagdds, contrast = c("species", wheat_species, sp))
    sig_res <- res[which(res$padj < 0.05), ]
    #sig_res <- res[which(res$pvalue < 0.05), ]
    if (nrow(sig_res) > 0) {
      sig_res_df <- as.data.frame(sig_res)
      sig_res_df$taxa <- rownames(sig_res_df)
      sig_res_df$comparison <- paste(wheat_species, "vs", sp)
      all_sig_results <- rbind(all_sig_results, sig_res_df)
    }
    
    cat("Completed comparison:", wheat_species, "vs", sp, "\n")
  }
}

# Save output
this_path <- '/Users/mathieuvanhove/Desktop/Work/DeepImpact/Weeds_wheat/paper_1/data/results_v4/'
output_dir <- file.path(this_path, "DESeq2_species")
if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)
write.csv(all_sig_results, file.path(output_dir, "DESeq_bacteria_Resistant_species_vs_wheat_x_wheat_padj.csv"), row.names = TRUE)
```

```{r - deseq2 microbiome - all wheat as controls}
# https://joey711.github.io/phyloseq-extensions/DESeq2.html 
wheat_species = "Controls"

# physeq_log2fold <- subset_samples(physeq, soil == "Permissive")  # Adjust to "Permissive" or "resistant" 
physeq_log2fold <- subset_samples(physeq, soil == "Permissive")

# Extract the sample data
metadata <- as.data.frame(sample_data(physeq_log2fold))
# Create the new "Controls" column based on "species"
# metadata_tmp$Controls <- ifelse(metadata_tmp$species %in% c("wheat alone", "wheat x wheat"), "control", "test")
metadata$Controls <- ifelse(metadata$species %in% c("wheat alone", "wheat x wheat"), 
                                "Controls", metadata$species)
# Assign the modified metadata back to the phyloseq object
sample_data(physeq_log2fold) <- sample_data(metadata)
# head(sample_data(physeq_log2fold)$Controls, 225)
count_data = as.data.frame(round(as.matrix(otu_table(physeq_log2fold)))) # force to be a df

# Create DESeq2 object
diagdds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = count_data,
  colData = metadata,
  design = ~ Controls  # Update design to use "species"
)
diagdds <- phyloseq_to_deseq2(physeq_log2fold, ~ Controls) # Controls; species
# Wald Uses Raw Counts but Needs Normalization for Library Size Differences
diagdds <- estimateSizeFactors(diagdds, type = "poscounts")  # Robust for sparse data
diagdds <- DESeq(diagdds, test="Wald", fitType="parametric")


metadata$Controls <- as.factor(metadata$Controls)
species_list <- levels(metadata$Controls)
all_sig_results <- data.frame()  # To store significant results

for (sp in species_list) {
  if (sp != wheat_species) {
    # Comparison: wheat_species vs sp
    res1 <- results(diagdds, contrast = c("Controls", wheat_species, sp))
    # sig_res1 <- res1[which(res1$padj < 0.05), ]
    sig_res1 <- res1[which(res1$pvalue < 0.05), ]

    # Comparison: sp vs wheat_species
    res2 <- results(diagdds, contrast = c("Controls", sp, wheat_species))
    # sig_res2 <- res2[which(res2$padj < 0.05), ]
    sig_res2 <- res2[which(res2$pvalue < 0.05), ]
    # Combine significant results for both directions
    if (nrow(sig_res1) > 0) {
      sig_res1_df <- as.data.frame(sig_res1)
      sig_res1_df$taxa <- rownames(sig_res1_df)
      sig_res1_df$comparison <- paste(wheat_species, "vs", sp)
      all_sig_results <- rbind(all_sig_results, sig_res1_df)
    }
    
    if (nrow(sig_res2) > 0) {
      sig_res2_df <- as.data.frame(sig_res2)
      sig_res2_df$taxa <- rownames(sig_res2_df)
      sig_res2_df$comparison <- paste(sp, "vs", wheat_species)
      all_sig_results <- rbind(all_sig_results, sig_res2_df)
    }
    
    # Print progress
    cat("Completed comparisons for:", wheat_species, "vs", sp, "\n")
  }
}
```

```{r - edgeR}
library(edgeR)
# Subset phyloseq data for resistant soil
physeq_log2fold <- subset_samples(physeq, soil == "Permissive") # resistant; Permissive
# physeq_log2fold <- physeq_soilA

# Extract sample metadata
metadata <- data.frame(sample_data(physeq_log2fold))
metadata$species <- factor(metadata$species)
# Ensure "wheat alone" is the reference level
metadata$species <- relevel(metadata$species, ref = "wheat x wheat")
# Convert OTU table to count data
physeq_log2fold_filtered <- filter_taxa(physeq_log2fold, function(x) sum(x > 0) >= 5, TRUE)
count_data <- as.data.frame(round(as.matrix(otu_table(physeq_log2fold_filtered))))
# Create DGEList object
dge <- DGEList(counts = count_data, group = metadata$species)
# Normalize with TMM
dge <- calcNormFactors(dge, method = "TMM")
# Create a design matrix with species as a factor
design <- model.matrix(~0 + species, data = metadata)  # Use 'species' explicitly
colnames(design) <- gsub("species", "", colnames(design))  # Clean column names
# Estimate dispersion
dge <- estimateDisp(dge, design)
# Fit the model
fit <- glmQLFit(dge, design)

# Get list of species, excluding control
# species_list <- setdiff(levels(metadata$species), "wheat x wheat")
control_species <- "wheat x wheat"
# Initialize results storage
all_sig_results <- data.frame()

colnames(design) <- make.names(colnames(design))  # Fix invalid column names
species_list <- make.names(species_list)          # Fix species names
control_species <- make.names("wheat x wheat")      # Fix control name

# Loop through each species for comparisons
for (sp in species_list) {
  if (sp != control_species) {
    # Create contrast correctly
    contrast_matrix <- makeContrasts(contrasts = paste0(sp, " - ", control_species), levels = design)
    # Run differential expression test
    result <- glmQLFTest(fit, contrast = contrast_matrix)
    # Extract significant results (FDR < 0.05)
    sig_res <- topTags(result, n = Inf)$table
    sig_res <- sig_res[sig_res$PValue < 0.05, ]  # Using raw p-value instead of FDR
    # sig_res <- sig_res[sig_res$FDR < 0.05, ]  # Using FDR filtering
    if (nrow(sig_res) > 0) {
      sig_res_df <- as.data.frame(sig_res)
      sig_res_df$taxa <- rownames(sig_res_df)
      sig_res_df$comparison <- paste(control_species, "vs", sp)
      all_sig_results <- rbind(all_sig_results, sig_res_df)
    }
    cat("Completed comparisons for:", control_species, "vs", sp, "\n")
  }
}
# View top significant results
head(all_sig_results)
all_sig_results$comparison <- gsub("Capsella\\.bursa\\.pastoris", "Capsella.bursa-pastoris", all_sig_results$comparison)
all_sig_results$comparison <- gsub("Legousia\\.speculum\\.veneris", "Legousia.speculum-veneris", all_sig_results$comparison)
all_sig_results$comparison <- gsub("Trigonella\\.foenum\\.graecum", "Trigonella.foenum-graecum", all_sig_results$comparison)

  dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}
# Save results to CSV
write.csv(all_sig_results, file = file.path(output_dir, "edgeR_bacteria_Permissive_vs_wheat_x_wheat.csv"), row.names = TRUE)
```

```{r - edge - all wheat as controls}
library(edgeR)
# Subset phyloseq data for resistant soil
physeq_log2fold <- subset_samples(physeq, soil == "Permissive") # resistant; Permissive
# physeq_log2fold <- physeq_soilB

# Extract metadata
metadata <- data.frame(sample_data(physeq_log2fold))
# Define "control" group based on species
metadata$Controls <- ifelse(metadata$species %in% c("wheat alone", "wheat x wheat"), "Controls", metadata$species)
# Ensure Controls is a factor and set "control" as the reference level
metadata$Controls <- relevel(factor(metadata$Controls), ref = "Controls")
# Convert OTU table to count data
physeq_log2fold_filtered <- filter_taxa(physeq_log2fold, function(x) sum(x > 0) >= 5, TRUE)
count_data <- as.data.frame(round(as.matrix(otu_table(physeq_log2fold_filtered))))
# Create DGEList object
dge <- DGEList(counts = count_data, group = metadata$Controls)
# Normalize with TMM
dge <- calcNormFactors(dge, method = "TMM")
# Create a design matrix with Controls as a factor
design <- model.matrix(~0 + Controls, data = metadata)
colnames(design) <- make.names(colnames(design))  # Fix invalid column names
# Estimate dispersion
dge <- estimateDisp(dge, design)
# Fit the model
fit <- glmQLFit(dge, design)
# Get list of species (excluding control)
species_list <- setdiff(levels(metadata$Controls), "Controls")
control_species <- "Controls"


# Initialize results storage
all_sig_results <- data.frame()
# Convert species names to valid R variable names
species_list <- make.names(species_list)
control_species <- make.names(control_species)
# Loop through each species for individual pairwise comparisons
for (sp in species_list) {
  if (sp != control_species) {
    contrast_sp <- paste0("Controls", sp)
    contrast_control <- paste0("Controls", control_species)
    # Create contrast for direct species vs control comparison
    contrast_matrix <- makeContrasts(contrasts = paste0(contrast_sp, " - ", contrast_control), levels = design)

    # Run differential expression test
    result <- glmQLFTest(fit, contrast = contrast_matrix)

    # Extract significant results (FDR < 0.05)
    sig_res <- topTags(result, n = Inf)$table
    #sig_res <- sig_res[sig_res$FDR < 0.05, ]  # Using FDR filtering
    sig_res <- sig_res[sig_res$PValue < 0.05, ]  # Using FDR filtering

    if (nrow(sig_res) > 0) {
      sig_res_df <- as.data.frame(sig_res)
      sig_res_df$taxa <- rownames(sig_res_df)
      sig_res_df$comparison <- paste(control_species, "vs", sp)
      all_sig_results <- rbind(all_sig_results, sig_res_df)
    }
    
    cat("Completed comparisons for:", control_species, "vs", sp, "\n")
  }
}

# View top significant results
```

effect size


```{r}
# ---- Setup ----
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

mypath_res <- '/Users/mathieuvanhove/Desktop/Work/DeepImpact/Weeds_wheat/paper_1/data/results_v4/'

# ---- Function that matches by position (order) not rownames ----
analyze_module_biomass_byorder <- function(module_file, mass_file, label) {
  
  cat("\n", rep("-", 60), "\n", sep = "")
  cat("ANALYZING:", label, "\n")
  cat(rep("-", 60), "\n", sep = "")
  
  # Load files
  mod_df <- read.csv(module_file, row.names = 1)
  mass_df <- read.csv(mass_file, row.names = 1)
  
  # Extract vectors (assuming they're in the same order)
  abundance_vec <- mod_df[, 1]
  biomass_vec <- mass_df[, 1]
  
  # Check if lengths match
  if(length(abundance_vec) != length(biomass_vec)) {
    cat("ERROR: Different number of samples!\n")
    cat("  Module abundance: n =", length(abundance_vec), "\n")
    cat("  Dry mass: n =", length(biomass_vec), "\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Get sample names from module file (these are the real sample IDs)
  sample_names <- rownames(mod_df)
  
  # Remove NAs
  valid_idx <- !is.na(abundance_vec) & !is.na(biomass_vec) & 
               is.finite(abundance_vec) & is.finite(biomass_vec)
  
  abundance_clean <- abundance_vec[valid_idx]
  biomass_clean <- biomass_vec[valid_idx]
  sample_names_clean <- sample_names[valid_idx]
  
  n_samples <- length(biomass_clean)
  
  cat("  Total samples:", length(abundance_vec), "\n")
  cat("  Valid samples after NA removal:", n_samples, "\n")
  
  if(n_samples < 3) {
    cat("ERROR: Not enough valid samples (n =", n_samples, ")\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Check variance
  if(sd(abundance_clean) == 0 | sd(biomass_clean) == 0) {
    cat("ERROR: No variance in data\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Spearman correlation
  cor_test <- cor.test(abundance_clean, biomass_clean, method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)
  rho <- as.numeric(cor_test$estimate)
  p_value <- cor_test$p.value
  
  # Linear model for R²
  lm_fit <- lm(biomass_clean ~ abundance_clean)
  r_squared <- summary(lm_fit)$r.squared
  adj_r_squared <- summary(lm_fit)$adj.r.squared
  
  # Pearson correlation
  pearson_test <- cor.test(abundance_clean, biomass_clean, method = "pearson")
  pearson_r <- as.numeric(pearson_test$estimate)
  pearson_p <- pearson_test$p.value
  
  # Effect size categorization
  effect_size <- case_when(
    r_squared < 0.01 ~ "negligible",
    r_squared < 0.09 ~ "small",
    r_squared < 0.25 ~ "medium",
    TRUE ~ "large"
  )
  
  # Compile results
  results <- data.frame(
    analysis = label,
    n_samples = n_samples,
    spearman_rho = round(rho, 3),
    spearman_p = ifelse(p_value < 0.001, "<0.001", sprintf("%.3f", p_value)),
    pearson_r = round(pearson_r, 3),
    pearson_p = ifelse(pearson_p < 0.001, "<0.001", sprintf("%.3f", pearson_p)),
    r_squared = round(r_squared, 3),
    adj_r_squared = round(adj_r_squared, 3),
    variance_explained_pct = round(r_squared * 100, 1),
    effect_size = effect_size,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  cat("  Spearman ρ =", round(rho, 3), ", p =", ifelse(p_value < 0.001, "<0.001", sprintf("%.3f", p_value)), "\n")
  cat("  R² =", round(r_squared, 3), "(", round(r_squared * 100, 1), "% variance explained)\n")
  cat("  Effect size:", effect_size, "\n")
  
  return(list(
    results = results,
    data = data.frame(
      sample = sample_names_clean,
      abundance = abundance_clean, 
      biomass = biomass_clean
    )
  ))
}

# ---- Run all analyses ----
cat(rep("=", 80), "\n", sep = "")
cat("MICROBE-BIOMASS EFFECT SIZE ANALYSIS\n")
cat(rep("=", 80), "\n", sep = "")

bact_A <- analyze_module_biomass_byorder(
  file.path(mypath_res, "mEQO", "eqo_module_soilA_abundance_bacteria.csv"),
```

```{r warning=FALSE}
library(gradientForest)
library(phyloseq)
library(vegan)
library(dplyr)

# ============================================================================
# COMPREHENSIVE GRADIENT FOREST DIAGNOSTIC AND FIX
# ============================================================================

# ============================================================================
# STEP 1: DIAGNOSTIC FUNCTION - Check data before running GF
# ============================================================================

diagnose_physeq_for_gf <- function(physeq, soil_label, kingdom_label) {
  
  cat("\n==========================================================\n")
  cat(sprintf("DIAGNOSING: %s - %s\n", kingdom_label, soil_label))
  cat("==========================================================\n\n")
  
  # Extract components
  if (taxa_are_rows(physeq)) {
    otu_mat <- t(as.matrix(otu_table(physeq)))
  } else {
    otu_mat <- as.matrix(otu_table(physeq))
  }
  
  meta <- data.frame(sample_data(physeq))
  
  # Sample names
  otu_samples <- rownames(otu_mat)
  meta_samples <- rownames(meta)
  
  cat("1. DIMENSIONS:\n")
  cat(sprintf("   OTU matrix: %d samples × %d taxa\n", nrow(otu_mat), ncol(otu_mat)))
  cat(sprintf("   Metadata: %d rows × %d columns\n", nrow(meta), ncol(meta)))
  cat(sprintf("   Sample names match: %s\n", 
              ifelse(identical(otu_samples, meta_samples), "YES ✓", "NO ✗")))
  
  if (!identical(otu_samples, meta_samples)) {
    common <- intersect(otu_samples, meta_samples)
    cat(sprintf("   Common samples: %d\n", length(common)))
    
    if (length(common) < length(otu_samples)) {
      missing_in_meta <- setdiff(otu_samples, meta_samples)
      cat(sprintf("   Missing in metadata: %d samples\n", length(missing_in_meta)))
      cat("   First few:", head(missing_in_meta, 3), "\n")
    }
    
    if (length(common) < length(meta_samples)) {
      missing_in_otu <- setdiff(meta_samples, otu_samples)
      cat(sprintf("   Missing in OTU: %d samples\n", length(missing_in_otu)))
      cat("   First few:", head(missing_in_otu, 3), "\n")
    }
  }
  
  cat("\n2. METADATA COLUMNS:\n")
  cat("   Available:", paste(colnames(meta), collapse = ", "), "\n")
  
  # Try to find biomass column
  possible_biomass <- c("Dry_wheat_mass", "Wheat_Biomass", "biomass", 
                        "dry_mass", "Wheat.biomass", "wheat_biomass")
  biomass_col <- NULL
  
  for (col in possible_biomass) {
    if (col %in% colnames(meta)) {
      biomass_col <- col
      break
    }
  }
  
  if (is.null(biomass_col)) {
    cat("   ✗ PROBLEM: Cannot find biomass column!\n")
    cat("   Looked for:", paste(possible_biomass, collapse = ", "), "\n")
    return(NULL)
  } else {
    cat(sprintf("   ✓ Found biomass column: '%s'\n", biomass_col))
  }
  
  # Check biomass values
  biomass <- meta[[biomass_col]]
  
  cat("\n3. BIOMASS VALUES:\n")
  cat(sprintf("   Total values: %d\n", length(biomass)))
  cat(sprintf("   NAs: %d\n", sum(is.na(biomass))))
  cat(sprintf("   Range: %.4f - %.4f\n", min(biomass, na.rm = TRUE), 
              max(biomass, na.rm = TRUE)))
  cat(sprintf("   Mean: %.4f (SD: %.4f)\n", mean(biomass, na.rm = TRUE), 
              sd(biomass, na.rm = TRUE)))
  
  if (sd(biomass, na.rm = TRUE) == 0) {
    cat("   ✗ PROBLEM: No variation in biomass!\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Show biomass distribution
  cat("   Quantiles:\n")
  print(quantile(biomass, na.rm = TRUE, probs = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1)))
  
  # Check OTU matrix
  cat("\n4. OTU MATRIX:\n")
  cat(sprintf("   Total entries: %d\n", length(otu_mat)))
  cat(sprintf("   Zeros: %d (%.1f%%)\n", sum(otu_mat == 0), 
              100 * sum(otu_mat == 0) / length(otu_mat)))
  cat(sprintf("   Range: %.2e - %.2e\n", min(otu_mat), max(otu_mat)))
  
  # Taxa prevalence
  taxa_prevalence <- colSums(otu_mat > 0) / nrow(otu_mat)
  cat(sprintf("   Taxa with prevalence > 10%%: %d\n", sum(taxa_prevalence > 0.1)))
  cat(sprintf("   Taxa with prevalence > 25%%: %d\n", sum(taxa_prevalence > 0.25)))
  
  cat("\n5. RECOMMENDED ACTIONS:\n")
  
  if (!identical(otu_samples, meta_samples)) {
    cat("   → Align sample names between OTU and metadata\n")
  }
  
  if (sum(is.na(biomass)) > 0) {
    cat(sprintf("   → Remove %d samples with missing biomass\n", sum(is.na(biomass))))
  }
  
  if (sum(taxa_prevalence < 0.05) > 0.5 * length(taxa_prevalence)) {
    cat("   → Consider filtering rare taxa (many taxa present in <5% samples)\n")
  }
  
  cat("\n==========================================================\n\n")
  
  return(list(
    otu_mat = otu_mat,
    metadata = meta,
    biomass_col = biomass_col,
    diagnostics_passed = TRUE
  ))
}

# ============================================================================
# STEP 2: CORRECTED GF FUNCTION WITH PROPER ERROR HANDLING
# ============================================================================

run_gf_corrected <- function(physeq, soil_type, kingdom, output_dir) {
  
  # Run diagnostics first
  diag <- diagnose_physeq_for_gf(physeq, soil_type, kingdom)
  
  if (is.null(diag)) {
    stop("Diagnostics failed. Fix issues above before proceeding.")
  }
  
  cat(sprintf("\n=== RUNNING GRADIENT FOREST: %s - %s ===\n", kingdom, soil_type))
  
  # Get cleaned data from diagnostics
  otu_mat <- diag$otu_mat
  meta <- diag$metadata
  biomass_col <- diag$biomass_col
  
  # Align samples
  common_samples <- intersect(rownames(otu_mat), rownames(meta))
  otu_mat <- otu_mat[common_samples, ]
  meta <- meta[common_samples, ]
  biomass <- meta[[biomass_col]]
  
  # Remove NAs
  valid <- !is.na(biomass)
  otu_mat <- otu_mat[valid, ]
  biomass <- biomass[valid]
  
  cat(sprintf("Working with: %d samples × %d taxa\n", nrow(otu_mat), ncol(otu_mat)))
  
  # Hellinger transformation
  otu_hell <- decostand(otu_mat, method = "hellinger")
  
  # Remove zero-variance taxa
  taxa_var <- apply(otu_hell, 2, var)
  otu_clean <- otu_hell[, taxa_var > 0]
  
  cat(sprintf("After variance filter: %d taxa\n", ncol(otu_clean)))
  
  # Create data frame
  gf_data <- data.frame(
    Wheat.biomass = biomass,
    otu_clean,
    check.names = FALSE
  )
  
  # Run GF
  cat("Running Gradient Forest...\n")
  
  gf_result <- gradientForest(
    data = gf_data,
    predictor.vars = "Wheat.biomass",
    response.vars = colnames(gf_data)[-1],
    ntree = 500,
    maxLevel = floor(log2(nrow(gf_data) * 0.368/2)),
    trace = TRUE,
    corr.threshold = 0.5
  )
  
  cat("GF complete. Extracting results...\n")
  
  # ============================================================================
  # ROBUST RESULT EXTRACTION
  # ============================================================================
  
  # Try multiple extraction methods
  results_df <- NULL
  
  # Method 1: importance() function
  tryCatch({
    imp <- importance(gf_result, type = "Species")
    
    # Check if it's a matrix/data.frame
    if (is.matrix(imp) || is.data.frame(imp)) {
      cat("Extraction method 1 successful (importance function)\n")
      
      results_df <- data.frame(
        spec = rownames(imp),
        var = "Wheat.biomass",
        rsq = if("R2" %in% colnames(imp)) imp[, "R2"] else NA,
        improve.tot = if("Weighted.Importance" %in% colnames(imp)) imp[, "Weighted.Importance"] else imp[, 1],
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    } else if (is.vector(imp)) {
      # Sometimes returns a vector
      cat("Extraction method 1b successful (importance as vector)\n")
      
      results_df <- data.frame(
        spec = names(imp),
        var = "Wheat.biomass",
        rsq = NA,
        improve.tot = as.numeric(imp),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("Method 1 failed:", e$message, "\n")
  })
  
  # Method 2: Direct extraction from object
  if (is.null(results_df)) {
    tryCatch({
      cat("Trying method 2 (direct extraction)...\n")
      
      # Check structure
      if (!is.null(gf_result$imp.rsq) && !is.null(gf_result$species.names)) {
        results_df <- data.frame(
          spec = gf_result$species.names,
          var = "Wheat.biomass",
          rsq = gf_result$imp.rsq,
          improve.tot = if(!is.null(gf_result$imp.vars)) gf_result$imp.vars else gf_result$imp.rsq,
          stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )
        cat("Extraction method 2 successful\n")
      }
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat("Method 2 failed:", e$message, "\n")
    })
  }
  
  # Method 3: Cumlative importance
  if (is.null(results_df)) {
    tryCatch({
      cat("Trying method 3 (cumlative importance)...\n")
      
      cum_imp <- cumimp(gf_result, "Wheat.biomass")
      
      if (!is.null(cum_imp) && length(cum_imp) > 0) {
        results_df <- data.frame(
          spec = names(cum_imp),
          var = "Wheat.biomass",
          rsq = NA,
          improve.tot = as.numeric(cum_imp),
          stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )
        cat("Extraction method 3 successful\n")
      }
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat("Method 3 failed:", e$message, "\n")
    })
  }
  
  if (is.null(results_df)) {
    stop("ERROR: All extraction methods failed. Cannot get results from GF object.")
  }
  
  # Add variance columns
  results_df$improve.tot.var <- results_df$improve.tot
  results_df$rsq.var <- results_df$rsq
  
  # Filter and sort
  results_df <- results_df %>%
    filter(!is.na(improve.tot), improve.tot > 0) %>%
    arrange(desc(improve.tot))
  
  # Save
  soil_letter <- ifelse(soil_type == "resistant", "A", "B")
  filename <- sprintf("%s_soil%s_species_df.csv", kingdom, soil_letter)
  write.csv(results_df, file.path(output_dir, filename), row.names = TRUE)
  
  cat(sprintf("\n✓ SUCCESS: %d important taxa\n", nrow(results_df)))
  cat(sprintf("✓ Saved: %s\n\n", filename))
  
  return(list(
    gf_result = gf_result,
    results_df = results_df,
    soil = soil_type,
    kingdom = kingdom
  ))
}

# STEP 3: USAGE EXAMPLE
# ============================================================================
```

```{r}
load_all_gf_results <- function(gf_dir) {
  
  # Load all four CSV files
  bacteria_A <- read.csv(file.path(gf_dir, "bacteria_soilA_species_df.csv"), 
                         row.names = 1, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  bacteria_B <- read.csv(file.path(gf_dir, "bacteria_soilB_species_df.csv"), 
                         row.names = 1, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  fungi_A <- read.csv(file.path(gf_dir, "fungi_soilA_species_df.csv"), 
                      row.names = 1, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  fungi_B <- read.csv(file.path(gf_dir, "fungi_soilB_species_df.csv"), 
                      row.names = 1, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  
  # Add metadata
  bacteria_A$Kingdom <- "Bacteria"
  bacteria_A$Soil <- "Cereal-dominated"
  bacteria_B$Kingdom <- "Bacteria"
  bacteria_B$Soil <- "Mixed-system"
  fungi_A$Kingdom <- "Fungi"
  fungi_A$Soil <- "Cereal-dominated"
  fungi_B$Kingdom <- "Fungi"
  fungi_B$Soil <- "Mixed-system"
  
  # Combine
  all_results <- bind_rows(
    bacteria_A, bacteria_B, fungi_A, fungi_B
  )
  
  cat(sprintf("Loaded %d total taxa with importance > 0\n", nrow(all_results)))
  cat(sprintf("  Bacteria cereal-dominated: %d taxa\n", nrow(bacteria_A)))
  cat(sprintf("  Bacteria mixed-system: %d taxa\n", nrow(bacteria_B)))
  cat(sprintf("  Fungi cereal-dominated: %d taxa\n", nrow(fungi_A)))
  cat(sprintf("  Fungi mixed-system: %d taxa\n", nrow(fungi_B)))
  
  return(list(
    bacteria_A = bacteria_A,
    bacteria_B = bacteria_B,
    fungi_A = fungi_A,
    fungi_B = fungi_B,
    combined = all_results
  ))
}

# ============================================================================
# PLOT 1: CUMULATIVE IMPORTANCE CURVES
# ============================================================================

plot_gf_cumulative_importance <- function(gf_results, kingdom_filter) {
  
  # Filter by kingdom
  data <- gf_results$combined %>%
    filter(Kingdom == kingdom_filter) %>%
    group_by(Soil) %>%
    arrange(desc(improve.tot)) %>%
    mutate(
      taxa_rank = row_number(),
      cumulative_importance = cumsum(improve.tot) / sum(improve.tot) * 100
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  # Create plot
  p <- ggplot(data, aes(x = taxa_rank, y = cumulative_importance, color = Soil)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = c(50, 80), linetype = "dashed", 
               color = "gray40", alpha = 0.6, linewidth = 0.4) +
    annotate("text", x = max(data$taxa_rank) * 0.95, y = 50, 
             label = "50%", hjust = 1, vjust = -0.5, 
             size = 3, color = "gray40") +
    annotate("text", x = max(data$taxa_rank) * 0.95, y = 80, 
             label = "80%", hjust = 1, vjust = -0.5, 
             size = 3, color = "gray40") +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c("Cereal-dominated" = "#E41A1C", "Mixed-system" = "#377EB8"),
      name = NULL
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100), expand = c(0.01, 0)) +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0.01, 0)) +
    labs(
      x = "Number of Taxa (ranked by importance)",
      y = "Cumulative Importance (%)",
      subtitle = kingdom_filter
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 11),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 10)
    )
  
  return(p)
}
```
